name: VANDIRA Monitoring + Performance Intelligence
purpose: Evidence-based operational observability for the VANDIRA election intelligence runtime.
rules: Measured latency is reported only when an endpoint was actually probed.
A slow endpoint is an operational signal, not evidence about political events.
Provider not configured is distinct from provider failure.
Current political claims still require fresh retrieval and source attribution.
Monitoring metrics must not include sensitive voter attributes or profiling.
Browser performance history is local-first and bounded.
No synthetic uptime percentage is claimed without an observed sample window.
